name: codebase-atlas
description: Codebase Atlas for Reverse Engineering: every claim about the code cites the path:line it rests on or says UNKNOWN, and a deterministic parser (graphify, tree-sitter, no LLM) counts the source files independently so that no file is left out of the component inventory. Advisory gate sensors check both.

atlas-graph.description: Count the source files with graphify (build) and check a code knowledge base's citations and coverage (check)
